name: Additional Material
overview: Download buttons for course material stored with your videos
description: Adds an "Additional material" download to courses, sections and lessons (series, seasons, episodes and movies) that have a matching .zip stored beside them: additional-material.zip in a series or season folder, or <video name>.material.zip beside a video. Course and section pages list the material below them; grid cards and list rows show an icon. Opt-in per library; downloads honor library access and the Download permission. Needs the File Transformation plugin for the web button.

versions.changelog: Redirect placeholders (Udemy quiz pages) get an Open link to the site they point at.
The plugin can build archives itself (Settings > Building, off by default), with the helper script's rules. One-file material is handed out as the file. Contents list left-out files.
Settings reorganized into sections with one Save bar; Reset to default for the accent color.
Contents view: see the files in each archive and download them one by one, including files in zips inside the material. Settings: Re-read folders.
Fixed: icons could vanish until a reload. Security (Windows): the link-signing key is no longer readable by every local user.
Fixed: grid and list icons sometimes needed a page reload to appear.
Security: zips under a linked folder (symlink or junction) are refused.
Icons appear at once: material is indexed at startup and after library scans. New task "Refresh additional material".
Descriptive download names; course and section listings; grid and list icons; new two-color icon; translatable text.
